title: Note for Draft Chapter on Approach to alternative rapid microbiological methods 11.06.2021
bodyHtml: The draft general chapter on “Approach to Alternative Rapid Microbiological Methods” has been uploaded on IPC website on 09th April 2021 for stakeholder’s comments. We have received many comments from various stakeholders. As 45 days completed we are removing this chapter from IPC website. Draft general chapter will be revised in coordination with Microbiology Expert Working Group for IP and uploaded on IPC website shortly
